title: Radio: S-7 and Engine 2 on Hollow Road, Then Red Cross

fields.centerName: Tallis County EOC — Courthouse Annex, Cedar Ford

lines.text: Command, S-7 on Hollow Road. Medical-needs list, house fourteen. Male, seventies, on home oxygen. Says he rode out '93 and '08 and he's not leaving his dog. His daughter's on the phone with him right now, begging him to go. Engine 2 has done nine of the twenty-two medical-needs households. Two more we can't get an answer at, and the cars are gone.

Command, Engine 2. Hollow Road barriers are up, one-way outbound. I've got two Hollow Court night aides at the barrier at Route 38 trying to drive in for the 18:00 load. They live across the river, came over the Route 38 bridge, and now they can't get in against the one-way. Care center says it can't move thirty-six residents without them.

lines.from: Red Cross Iowa region shelter lead (phone to EOC)
lines.text: We can staff Cedar Ford High School for four hundred, but the school district says the field house is full of track equipment until a custodian clears it. That's where the pet area goes, so it's 19:00 at the earliest. Who's telling the families with dogs where to go before then?

Command, S-7 on Hollow Road. We're handing out advisory flyers only, so it's voluntary. Out of the first thirty doors, maybe four are packing. The rest say call us when it's mandatory. House fourteen on the medical-needs list, man in his seventies on home oxygen, says the same. Hollow Road is still two-way, and there's a line of pickups going in to haul out furniture.

Command, Engine 2 at Hollow Court. Two night aides just told me Meadowview released the thirty-six beds at 15:00, and the van company let the eight vans go. The administrator is sending both aides to Ferris Crossing Community Hall to set up cots tonight. Four of her residents are on oxygen and the hall has no concentrators. She's asking whether the county's three paratransit buses are coming, and when.

lines.from: Red Cross Iowa region shelter lead (phone to EOC)
lines.text: Your plan says the high school opens when an order is issued, and you haven't issued one. Do we stand up Cedar Ford High School tonight or not? The field house pet area can't be ready before 19:00 either way, and I have to release my volunteers by 17:00 if you don't need them.

fields.voiceStyle: S-7: male deputy, 40s, steady but clipped, road noise. Engine 2: female fire officer, 30s, brisk and practical. Red Cross lead: middle-aged woman on a phone, organized, pressed for time.

instructorNote: Play only the A lines if the Coordinator issued the mandatory Cedar Hollow order at I-11, or only the B lines if the Coordinator held at the voluntary advisory. With A, watch for Field to log house 14 as a refusal and report the two households nobody answered at, PW to escort the aides in against the one-way, and EM to confirm the high school opening with a place to hold pets until 19:00. With B, watch for EM to see that the advisory isn't moving people and the care center's plan has fallen apart while the 20:00 order deadline is still running, then issue the order or record the reason for waiting, send the paratransit buses and oxygen, and give the Red Cross a clear answer.
